Opportunity matching

A match score
you can question.

The score is a weighted sum of eight factors. Each one is shown with its weight and reason, so you see why an opportunity is on the list, not just that it is.

  • Requirement extractionTurns a sentence like “5,000 customers, 45 days, AED 100k” into structured fields you confirm.
  • Matching and rankingScores every listing against audience, area, budget, timing, objective, availability and evidence.
  • Package builderCombines listings into mixes that fit the budget, with the platform fee shown on its own line.
  • RFQ and offer normalisationWrites one standard RFQ, then brings each reply to the same basis: price, setup, VAT, fee, dates, reporting.

It never invents reach, performance or ROI. Missing data lowers the confidence score instead.

    Ground rules

    What we will not do.
    So you can trust the numbers.

    Own inventory

    We do not own screens, spaces or venues and do not resell them. Suppliers set their own prices.

    Invent performance

    Reach, footfall and results appear only with a source and date. If there is no data, we say so.

    Promise ROI

    Cost per outcome is calculated only from results you and the supplier report after the booking.

    Hide the fee

    The platform fee is its own line on every package, offer and checkout.

    Pricing

    Free to brief. Pay when you book.

    During the Dubai pilot, the platform earns a transaction fee on booked opportunities. Subscriptions come later, and only if repeat use proves them worthwhile.

    FAQ

    Common questions.
    Clear answers.

    What the platform does, what it costs and how it handles data.

    Question not listed?

    Write to the founding team. We reply personally.

    visionseven@gmail.com
    Send a message
    01Is this an advertising agency or a DOOH network?
    Neither. We do not own media or buy it on your behalf. The platform matches your objective with opportunities listed by independent suppliers and runs the procurement: RFQ, offer comparison, approval and payment.
    02What counts as a commercial opportunity?
    Anything a supplier can offer that helps you reach an outcome: mall activations, residential or gym sampling, café and retail partnerships, office and campus activations, event sponsorship, pop-up space, indoor media and digital follow-up.
    03How is the match score calculated?
    It is a weighted sum of eight factors: objective fit, audience, geography, budget fit, timing, availability, historical evidence and data confidence. Each factor and weight is shown next to the score.
    04Do you guarantee reach or results?
    No. Reach and performance appear only when a supplier has provided them, labelled with the source and whether they were verified. Results after a booking are reported by the supplier and by you.
    05What does it cost?
    Briefing, planning, comparing and sending RFQs is free. When you book, a 7% platform fee is added as a separate line. Suppliers list for free during the pilot.
    06Which areas do you cover?
    The pilot starts in Dubai with a limited set of categories where discovery and pricing are hardest. Other emirates follow once the Dubai network works.
    07How are supplier offers compared?
    Every reply uses the same form. The platform adds setup costs, 5% VAT and the platform fee, then shows total, cost per day, date match, reporting level and payment terms side by side.
    08How do payments work?
    You pay once at checkout by card, bank transfer or invoice for approved accounts. The supplier is paid after you confirm delivery. In this prototype, payments are simulated and no money moves.
    09Can I use Arabic?
    Yes. The website and the platform work in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left layout. Use the language button in the header.
    10Where is my data stored in the prototype?
    Only in your own browser. Nothing you enter in the prototype is sent to a server. You can reset the demo data at any time from the platform header.
